resources.title: Agent execution
resources.description: Explains how agents execute approved plans through clio MCP, including transport rules, execution order, branching, evidence, and recovery patterns.

resources.title: Application modeling
resources.description: Guides Creatio application modeling, schema design decisions, and the page and data workflows used to implement an approved application plan.

resources.title: Workplaces
resources.description: Guides Creatio navigation workplace management: creating, updating and deleting a workplace, granting or removing role visibility, adding, removing and moving sections, and shipping every change as a package data binding.

resources.title: ATF.Repository development
resources.description: Shows how to read and write Creatio data with ATF.Repository models, providers, data contexts, relation mapping, and supported query patterns. Use when configuring `IDataProvider` or writing CRUD logic through `IAppDataContext`. If the task creates or changes repository models or their members, also use `atf-repository-model-management`.

resources.title: ATF.Repository model management
resources.description: Explains how to generate, organize, validate, and update ATF.Repository models for the exact Creatio schemas and members an implementation needs. This skill must be used whenever a task creates, extends, merges, or selects ATF.Repository models or their members. Use for requests like `Add models Account (Name, Owner, Owner.DecisionRole, Owner.DecisionRole.Name)` or `Add Account model (Name, Owner, Owner.DecisionRole, Owner.DecisionRole.Name), Order (Number, Account, Opportunity.Title)`.

resources.title: ATF.Repository tests
resources.description: Guides unit and integration testing for code that uses ATF.Repository models, relations, providers, and data contexts, including `MemoryDataProviderMock` and `IDataStore` setup, `AppDataContextFactory.GetAppDataContext(...)`, model-schema registration, seeded in-memory data, and repository assertions after query or save operations. If the task creates or changes repository models or their members, also use `atf-repository-model-management`.

resources.title: Creatio custom MCP tool reference
resources.description: Educational reference workspace for implementing, publishing, discovering, authenticating to, and invoking a custom C# MCP tool directly in Creatio.

resources.title: Creatio Google Pub/Sub reference
resources.description: Vetted reference workspace for Google Pub/Sub request/reply, publishing, streaming subscriptions, native-library lifecycle, tests, and a round-trip console in Creatio.

resources.title: Creatio Kafka reference
resources.description: Vetted reference workspace for Kafka request/reply, notifications, background consumers, native-library lifecycle, tests, and a round-trip console in Creatio.

resources.title: Branding
resources.description: Guides Creatio environment branding: product logos, the shell background image, and the browser-tab favicon, including the license check and the settings each asset is written to.

resources.title: Business rule filters
resources.description: Defines the apply-static-filter friendly filter contract for Freedom UI business rules: leaf comparisons, lookup values, forward paths, nested groups, backward EXISTS/NOT_EXISTS and COUNT/SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX aggregations, relative-date and current-user macros, age/birthday translation, multilingual handling, and the discovery flow.

resources.title: Business rules
resources.description: Guides entity-level and page-level Freedom UI business rules for visibility, editability, required state, value assignment, and lookup filtering.

resources.title: Chart widgets
resources.description: Guides Freedom UI chart widgets, including chart and series selection, aggregation, runtime configuration, and static filter authoring.

resources.title: Composable app end-to-end test implementation
resources.description: Describes a repeatable cross-repository delivery flow for implementing and validating composable-app end-to-end tests against a Creatio environment.

resources.title: Composable app repository bootstrap
resources.description: Explains how to initialize an app-specific repository from the composable-app starter without overwriting files that have already been customized.

resources.title: Configuration entity event listeners
resources.description: Create or review Creatio configuration entity event listeners implemented as `Terrasoft.Core.Entities.Events.BaseEntityEventListener` with `[EntityEventListener(SchemaName = "...")]`. Use when adding or changing entity lifecycle handling such as `OnSaving`, `OnSaved`, `OnInserting`, `OnInserted`, `OnUpdating`, `OnUpdated`, `OnDeleting`, `OnDeleted`, or direct event subscriptions like `entity.Validating` for a specific schema.

resources.title: Configuration entity event listener tests
resources.description: Write, update, or review tests for Creatio configuration entity event listeners built on `BaseEntityEventListener`. Use when creating tests that instantiate the listened entity schema, prepare minimal entity data, create a fresh listener instance, invoke the required lifecycle methods such as `OnSaving`, `OnSaved`, `OnInserting`, `OnUpdating`, `OnDeleting`, or validation hooks in the correct order, and verify helper calls or validation results.

resources.title: Configuration web services
resources.description: Guides implementation of Creatio configuration web services, including routes, DTOs, status codes, service composition, and runtime verification.

resources.title: Configuration web service tests
resources.description: Guides tests for Creatio configuration web services, including local fixtures, endpoint coverage, HTTP results, and assertion patterns.

resources.title: Core rules
resources.description: The non-negotiable clio MCP invariants (compile/restart, long-running await, profile culture, destructive confirmation, verification in browser preference, correlation-id) that apply to every operation. The server instructions mandate reading this first on any operation.

resources.title: Creatio composable app development
resources.description: Provides the source-level workflow for Creatio packages, Freedom UI schemas, page changes, compilation, deployment, and verification in a composable app repository.

resources.title: Creatio Freedom UI iframe section
resources.description: Explains how to create a minimal Freedom UI section that hosts an external application through one crt.IFrame component.

resources.title: Creatio custom C# MCP tools
resources.description: Guides implementation, package-data publication, direct authentication and invocation, catalogue refresh, troubleshooting, and testing of custom C# MCP source-code actions hosted by Creatio.

resources.title: Dashboard and home page layout
resources.description: Guides layout, sizing, grouping, and styling of analytical widgets on dashboards and home pages, including the 12-column grid, the metric-band-then-chart-grid skeleton, per-widget-type default sizes, and the plain-white (without-fill) card theme.

resources.title: Dashboard creation
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for creating a Freedom UI dashboard page via create-page with BaseDashboardTemplate, and resolving the DashboardsEntitySchemaName / DashboardsElementName / DashboardsClientUnitSchemaUId optional properties (including the root-schema UId rule).

resources.title: Dashboard design
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for the dashboard-specific DashboardDS hidden page data source that a dashboard's widgets filter by via a dependencies entry; general widget layout/sizing/styling lives in the dashboard-and-home-page-layout guide.

resources.title: Dashboard rights
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for reading and changing a dashboard's record-level access rights (new or existing dashboard) via get-record-rights / set-record-rights, and shipping those grants with the dashboard's package as a SysSchemaAdminUnitRight data binding so they survive a transfer.

resources.title: Dashboards
resources.description: The clio MCP dashboards router: a names-only index that routes dashboard work to dashboard-creation (create the page), dashboard-and-home-page-layout (widget layout/sizing/styling), dashboard-design (the DashboardDS filter-by-page-data binding), and indicator-widget / chart-widget (per-widget payload).

resources.title: Data bindings
resources.description: Guides generic Creatio data bindings, lookup seeding, and binding artifact creation, installation, and validation workflows.

resources.title: DataForge orchestration
resources.description: Defines the four-layer DataForge orchestration protocol for agents that model and implement Creatio applications through clio MCP.

resources.title: Deployment lifecycle
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for the Creatio deploy/provisioning lifecycle: assert-infrastructure -> show-passing-infrastructure -> find-empty-iis-port -> deploy-creatio/deploy-identity, plus build discovery, registration, IdentityService, and cliogate installation.

resources.title: Describe environment
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for describe-environment: classified base-probe failures, the single source-independent environment report (coreVersion, db engine, framework, productName, licenseInfo, locale/workspace metadata), which source supplies each field, and the cliogate / CanManageSolution prerequisites.

resources.title: DataService UPSERT
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for Creatio DataService UpdateQuery IsUpsert: query-then-update-or-insert semantics, match-key and insert-value discipline, multi-match risk, response handling, and uniqueness-backed concurrency safety.

resources.title: Desktop pages
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for Creatio desktop pages (desktop-selector workspaces): create-page with template CentralAreaDesktopTemplate, the Desktop schema-group invariant, automatic Desktop-entity registration by the platform, the FixedGridSlot_qwe4asds editable-slot rule, and record-rights-based selector visibility.

resources.title: EntitySchemaQuery
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for EntitySchemaQuery authoring: the DataService SelectQuery envelope, columns/select, expression building blocks, forward/backward reference column-path grammar, aggregations, and master enum tables. Filter construction and parsing are routed through `esq-filters`.

resources.title: Backend ESQ filter parsing
resources.description: Explains how backend C# code inspects and recursively parses `EntitySchemaQuery.Filters`: filter groups, leaf filters, operands, disabled nodes, and negation.

resources.title: ESQ filters
resources.description: Routes ESQ filter work to frontend/DataService filter construction, native backend C# construction, or backend filter parsing guidance.

resources.title: Backend ESQ filter construction
resources.description: Guides creation of EntitySchemaQuery filters with Creatio's native backend C# API, including values, groups, comparisons, and nesting.

resources.title: Frontend ESQ filter construction
resources.description: Guides creation and serialization of EntitySchemaQuery filters in JavaScript: Freedom UI, page JSON, and DataService SelectQuery payloads.

resources.title: Existing application maintenance
resources.description: Guides discovery, inspection, and minimal safe mutation of existing Creatio applications and their packages, schemas, and pages.

resources.title: Feature toggles
resources.description: Implement or review Creatio feature-toggle checks in C# package code such as packages/PkgOne/Files/src/cs or packages/PkgOne/src/cs. Use when gating behavior on a Creatio feature flag, adding `Creatio.FeatureToggling.Features.GetIsEnabled(...)`, or moving feature names into `Constants.cs`. If the task includes unit tests, also use feature-toggle-tests.

resources.title: Feature toggle tests
resources.description: Write, update, or review unit tests for Creatio feature-toggle behavior in package test projects such as tests/PkgOne or package-local test folders. Use when mocking a feature state with `FeatureRequest` and `Creatio.FeatureToggling.TestKit.FeatureStub.Setup(...)`, adding enabled and disabled coverage, or moving feature names into `Constants.cs`. Pair with feature-toggle when production code changes.

resources.title: Freedom UI web to mobile page conversion
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for converting a source page into a Freedom UI MOBILE page via get-mobile-page-conversion-guide: advisory guide (detected sourceType, recommended template, container map, component suggestions, inline mobile contracts), the model-driven flow where you build the body with create-page/update-page/validate-page, the five component categories, the Freedom-UI-only precondition (Classic UI must be converted to Freedom UI web first), mobile constraints, and how to finish in Freedom UI Mobile Designer.

resources.title: Home page
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for creating a Freedom UI home page (BaseHomePage) and making it a workplace's home page by binding SysWorkplace.HomePageUId as a package data binding.

resources.title: Identity assertion and token exchange
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for the Creatio identity-assertion / Identity Service V3 token-exchange flow used by the embedded AI chat: onboarding sequence (regenerate key, export public JWK, register with V3, issue assertion, exchange), the EnableIdentityAssertionIssuer feature and CanManageIdentityAssertionIssuer permission prerequisites, the four clio tools, and troubleshooting.

resources.title: Indicator widgets
resources.description: Guides Freedom UI indicator widgets, including aggregation, runtime configuration, intent translation, and static filter authoring.

resources.title: Integration testing
resources.description: Guides portable Creatio integration tests, ATF.Repository data access, process scenarios, CI authentication, Allure reporting, and optional browser-based validation.

resources.title: Knowledge feedback
resources.description: Defines task-end reconciliation when observed behavior contradicts guidance, including standing approval, report scope, evidence, privacy, deduplication, and agent-owned GitHub submission.

resources.title: Mobile page modification
resources.description: Mobile-specific differences from the base page-modification guidance: plain JSON body format (no AMD), crt.Scaffold root element rules, the mobile component registry, naming conventions, template hierarchy, and the supported request catalogue.

resources.title: Package dependencies
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for managing Creatio package dependencies: the schema-designer 'GetSchemaDesignItem returned an HTML error page' recovery via add-package-dependency (missing dependency on the owner of the extended object's upper layer), the symmetric remove-package-dependency cleanup, and the anti-patterns (no writes into the owning managed package, no raw SQL/OData/DataService dependency edits).

resources.title: Page creation
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for creating Freedom UI pages from supported templates via create-page: the list-page-templates -> create-page -> get-page flow, the supported web/mobile template catalog, required and optional inputs, validation/failure modes, and designer-type mapping.

resources.title: Page modification
resources.description: Entry guidance for Freedom UI page modification: the mandatory pre-edit GATE checklist and canonical flow, routing the detailed mechanics to the page-modification-overview / -field-contract / -containers / -components sub-guides (each kept small so one get-guidance response fits the agent token limit).

resources.title: Page modification components
resources.description: viewConfigDiff-composition sub-guide of the page-modification family: adding a button with a click handler, the handlers/viewConfigDiff section rules, the column-type-to-control mapping, the canonical add-button flow, and how to read a get-component-info detail response.

resources.title: Page modification containers
resources.description: Container-discovery sub-guide of the page-modification family: bundle.json top-level shape, jq recipes for walking viewConfig/containers, and how to pick a valid parentName from bundle.containers for a new component.

resources.title: Page modification field contract
resources.description: Inserted-field contract sub-guide of the page-modification family: viewModelConfigDiff attribute binding, the label/resource rule, static-vs-diff body forms, the canonical NumberInput payload, data-source declaration, and the validation diagnostics emitted on contract violation.

resources.title: Page modification lifecycle
resources.description: Page-body save-lifecycle sub-guide of the page-modification family: canonical get-page/update-page/sync-pages flow, replacing-schema concept, design-package resolution, write modes (replace/append/diff), do-not-resend-full-body, external-modification conflicts, body formatting, and known limitations.

resources.title: Page schema converters
resources.description: Guides creation and editing of Freedom UI converters in raw page schema bodies.

resources.title: Creatio DevKit common page APIs
resources.description: Guides supported uses of @creatio-devkit/common in deployed Freedom UI handlers, validators, converters, and related schema-body code.

resources.title: Page schema handlers
resources.description: Guides creation and editing of Freedom UI request handlers in raw page schema bodies.

resources.title: Page schema resources
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for Freedom UI page localizable strings: $Resources.Strings.* as the recommended binding, #ResourceString()# required for validator params (and conventional for grid captions), resources parameter usage, and common mistakes.

resources.title: Page schema validators
resources.description: Guides creation and editing of Freedom UI validators in raw page schema bodies.

resources.title: Process modeling
resources.description: Guides declarative Creatio business-process design, process inspection, mutation, and connection rules R1-R17 over the full BPMN catalog. What create-business-process can build today is a slice of that catalog — Simple/Signal start, end, user tasks, the fully configurable Send email element (custom message: mode, sender, recipients, subject, HTML body, options, manual-mode performer; no email templates), and sequence flows; gateways, conditional/default flows and timers are not buildable yet.

resources.title: Record rights
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for record-level access rights: read/change who can access a record or dashboard with get-record-rights / set-record-rights, addressing a dashboard as SysSchemaAdminUnit + schema UId, and the record-level (SysSchemaAdminUnitRight) vs operation-level (SysSchemaOperationRight) distinction.

resources.title: Related lists
resources.description: Guides adding Freedom UI related lists and scoping child records to the current page through declarative master-detail dependencies — no handler. Fetch the 'Expanded list' composite structure via get-component-info.

resources.title: Page-to-object binding
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for binding Freedom UI pages to an object via create-related-page-addon: choosing the default record page and the add-record page (optionally per role and type), name discovery, the replace-not-merge semantics, and error handling.

resources.title: Routing
resources.description: The canonical clio MCP routing map: a two-level, names-only table that maps a task (pages, entities, data, applications) to the get-guidance article(s) to read before acting. The server instructions mandate reading this first on any operation.

resources.title: Run process buttons
resources.description: Guides adding a Freedom UI button that starts a Creatio business process with the correct request, parameters, and page context.

resources.title: Server-to-server OAuth
resources.description: Guides use of Creatio server-to-server OAuth client credentials: minting `client_credentials` tokens, handling expiry without refresh tokens, calling Creatio APIs with an `Authorization: Bearer` token, secret handling, verification, and troubleshooting.

resources.title: Support mode
resources.description: Guides diagnostic-first execution in support mode, including severity routing, confirmation probes, fail-fast evidence, and reporting.

resources.title: System settings
resources.description: Implement or review Creatio system-setting access in C# package code such as packages/PkgOne/Files/src/cs or packages/PkgOne/src/cs. Use when reading a system setting with `Terrasoft.Core.Configuration.SysSettings.TryGetValue(...)`, `GetValue(...)`, or `GetDefValue(...)`, introducing or reusing `Constants.SysSettingCodes.<SettingName>`, or replacing inline sys-setting code strings with package constants. If the task includes unit tests, also use sys-setting-tests.

resources.title: System setting tests
resources.description: Write, update, or review unit tests for Creatio system-setting behavior in package test projects such as tests/PkgOne or package-local test folders. Use when decorating a test class with `[MockSettings(RequireMock.All)]`, overriding `SetupSysSettings()`, configuring `FakeSysSettings`, mocking `FakeSysSettingsEngine` for `GetValue`, `GetDefValue`, or `TryGetValue`, or replacing inline sys-setting code strings with `Constants.SysSettingCodes`. Pair with sys-setting when production code changes.

resources.title: System settings MCP operations
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for the Creatio sys-settings CRU surface: tool order, supported value-type-names and aliases, Lookup resolution, SecureText masking, Date/Time TZ caveat, and Binary (write-only, via value-file-path) upload.

resources.title: Custom themes
resources.description: Guides creation, modification, deletion, discovery, application, reset, default selection, and deployment of custom Creatio themes.

resources.title: Freedom UI projects
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for scaffolding a Freedom UI Angular remote-module project inside an existing clio workspace via new-ui-project: required arguments, naming constraints, file placement, and the create-workspace prerequisite.

resources.title: Virtual entities
resources.description: Guides creation and verification of a virtual entity object, IEntityQueryExecutor implementation, querying, and Creatio 10.0+ EntityEventListener writes.

resources.title: When to use requests
resources.description: Canonical MCP guidance for wiring Freedom UI page actions to platform requests: when to reuse a built-in crt.*Request vs chain a handler vs author a usr.*Request, and the mandatory get-request-info catalog discipline — parameters as the only authorable keys (empty map = no params block), platform-injected baseParameters never in params, per-request documentation, and version scoping.
